{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.66

|gr1= Bitwise

|descr= Performs bitwise NOT operation on decimal or hexadecimal unsigned 24 bit integer <br>(Hexadecimal number representation is simply auto-converted into decimal by the engine)<br><br>
'''Limitations''':<br>
Due to various limitations of the Real Virtuality engine this function is 
intended to work with unsigned 24 bit integers only. This means that the 
supported range is 2^0...2^24 (1...16777216)

|s1= num call [[BIS_fnc_bitwiseNOT]]

|p1= num: [[Number]] - decimal or hexadecimal unsigned 24 bit integer

|r1= [[Number]] - decimal number

|x1=<sqf>873687 call BIS_fnc_bitwiseNOT; // 15903528
[2 + 4 + 8 + 32 + 256 + 1024] call BIS_fnc_bitwiseNOT; // 16775889</sqf>

|seealso=    [[BIS_fnc_bitwiseAND]] [[BIS_fnc_bitwiseXOR]] [[BIS_fnc_bitwiseOR]]
}}
